recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-22713 unless Patient Care later chooses to revisit broader AllergyIntolerance note/description guidance separately.
issue_request: FHIR-22713 was a Published/Persuasive Patient Care change request to correct AllergyIntolerance.lastOccurrence comments that said textual date representations should use the Comment element; the accepted resolution was to say AllergyIntolerance.note instead. The issue description also mentioned AllergyIntolerance.reaction.description, but Jira comments record that this was already handled by GF#22650.
initial_application: The change was initially applied by fd40a53e88, which updated the old source/allergyintolerance/allergyintolerance-spreadsheet.xml wording from 'Comment element should be used' to 'AllergyIntolerance.note element should be used'. The current source has since moved to StructureDefinition XML and retains the corrected guidance.
additional_context: AllergyIntolerance is active in source/fhir.ini. Later commit 87813f0928 renamed AllergyIntolerance.lastOccurrence to AllergyIntolerance.lastReactionOccurrence while preserving the corrected note comment, and source/fhir.ini keeps aliases from the old element name to the current one. Zulip and Confluence searches found no relevant conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current source/allergyintolerance/structuredefinition-AllergyIntolerance.xml already says textual last-occurrence dates should use the AllergyIntolerance.note element, and source-wide search found no remaining Comment element or comment field wording for this issue.

related_jiras.note: FHIR-22713 comments say AllergyIntolerance.reaction.description had already been clarified under GF#22650, so it was not independently reconciled here.
Later rename work changed lastOccurrence to lastReactionOccurrence while preserving the corrected note guidance.
Paired with FHIR-43825 in the later rename commit that preserved the corrected note guidance.
